title: fix: C_Login SO attempt with open RO session returns wrong code
description:
pkcs11test ReadOnlySessionTest.SOLoginFail, ReadWriteSessionTest.ReadOnlySessionSOLoginFail, RWUserSessionTest.SOLoginFail confirm:
- C_Login(CKU_SO) when a read-only session is open should return CKR_SESSION_READ_ONLY_EXISTS
- Instead wolfP11 returns CKR_USER_ALREADY_LOGGED_IN or falls through the CKU_SO no-op path

PKCS#11 2.40 §11.16: C_Login with CKU_SO must return CKR_SESSION_READ_ONLY_EXISTS if any RO session is open on the token.
This check must happen before any authentication attempt.

Related to wolfP11-drz (CKU_SO not handled). The session-state check is a prerequisite to the CKU_SO authentication path.
